notes: This portable C++ TCK slice checks standard HLAobjectInstancesDeleted values through only official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, the adapter-supplied application FOM and standard MIM, HLAsetTiming, HLAinteger32BE, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies provider package, FOM, MIM, endpoint, callback model, logical-time implementation, and application object/attribute names. It checks direct count deltas after two accepted Delete Object Instance calls and the corresponding receiver-side removal callbacks, followed by the periodic count and standard MOM reflection metadata. It does not rely on provider headers, private registries, vendor-specific names, or diagnostic interfaces.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador joined-federate MOM lookup, subscription, direct update request, object registration and deletion, and standard HLAsetTiming interaction, with FederateAmbassador discovery, removal, and reflection callbacks
